description: This file implements a Speechmatics Speech-to-Text (STT) service integration within a larger speech processing framework. It defines configuration classes, manages connection lifecycle, handles incoming messages from the Speechmatics API, and processes speech segments into frames for downstream processing.

classes.name: TurnDetectionMode
classes.description: Enum representing different endpoint and turn detection handling modes for the STT engine.

classes.name: SpeechmaticsSTTService
classes.description: Main class implementing the Speechmatics speech-to-text service, managing connection, message handling, configuration, and frame processing.

classes.name: SpeechmaticsSTTService.InputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Speechmatics STT service, including language, speaker focus, diarization, and advanced options.

classes.name: SpeechmaticsSTTService.UpdateParams
classes.description: Parameters for updating the speaker focus and diarization settings during an active session.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SpeechmaticsSTTService with API credentials, configuration, and connection setup.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the Speechmatics WebSocket API, sets up message handlers, and starts message processing.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection to the Speechmatics API and cleans up resources.

methods.name: _handle_message
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to specific handlers based on message type.

methods.name: _handle_partial_segment
methods.description: Processes partial speech segments received from Speechmatics.

methods.name: _handle_segment
methods.description: Processes final speech segments received from Speechmatics.

methods.name: _handle_start_of_turn
methods.description: Handles start of speech turn events, signals user speech start, and interrupts bot speech if needed.

methods.name: _handle_end_of_turn
methods.description: Handles end of speech turn events, signals user speech end.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, manages bot and user speech states, and triggers finalization if needed.

methods.name: _send_frames
methods.description: Converts speech segments into frames and sends them downstream, handling final and interim results.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends control messages to the Speechmatics API.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Records and traces transcriptions (implementation not shown).

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Feeds audio data to Speechmatics and yields processing results.

methods.name: _emit_metrics
methods.description: Calculates and updates TTFB metrics based on processing time.

methods.name: _language_to_speechmatics_language
methods.description: Converts internal language enum to Speechmatics language code.

methods.name: _locale_to_speechmatics_locale
methods.description: Converts language enum to Speechmatics locale code.

methods.name: _check_deprecated_args
methods.description: Handles deprecated constructor arguments and migrates them to new parameters.
